Commentary.Commentary: Right then! The T20 World Cup is underway and we have had two great matches on the first day. The action now moves to Group A now. On 18th October, Ireland will face Netherlands at 2 pm Local (10 am GMT) and then Sri Lanka will face Namibia at 6 pm Local (2 pm GMT). Make sure you join us for that. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Kyle Coetzer, the skipper of Scotland, says that the Bangladeshi bowlers were outstanding and they were blown away a bit. Adds that Greaves was sensational with the bat and they have a lot of belief in their squad. Further adds that winning a game like this does boost their confidence a lot and this further strengthens their belief. Says that they will analyze after this game about how they can improve their game further. Finishes by saying that the team members really back each other.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, says the wicket was good and the target was chaseable. Credits his bowlers by saying that they bowled really well but it was their batters who did not perform well. Adds that Scotland batted well after losing wickets in the middle overs. Tells that they will regroup and hopes that they do not repeat these mistakes in the next game and win the match. Signs off by saying that the wicket was very good to bat on but they need to pull their socks up now.

Chris Greaves, PLAYER OF THE MATCH, says they were in trouble and it does not always go that way, they needed to re-build and he is delighted he could be the one to play the crucial knock. States they had something to bowl at and power-hitting at the end was unbelievable. Adds he is glad he could contribute to his team's success. Finishes by saying that it feels incredible to be a Scottish cricketer at this moment.

What a show it was by Scotland! They were pumped up thanks to the blazing finish they got to their batting and came out with intent in the field. All the bowlers except for Michael Leask bowled really well and kept the pressure on the batters. Brad Wheal got 3 wickets and went for only 24 runs in his spell. Chris Greaves got 2 wickets while Josh Davey and Mark Watt chipped in with 1 wicket each. It was a team performance by them and even their fielding was superb. Calum MacLeod in particular was brilliant and took 3 catches in the field. Safyaan Sharif did go for runs in the last over but they had enough in their kitty to win this game. Overall, they will be very happy with their show in the game. This is just the way they would have wanted to start their campaign in the T20 World Cup.

Bangladesh would have wanted a good start given the kind of experience they have in their batting ranks but that did not happen. Soumya Sarkar and Liton Das fell very cheaply and they were 18 for 2. Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim then repaired things with a good stand in the middle but the required run rate kept creeping up. First, Shakib Al Hasan fell while looking to up the ante and then Mushfiqur Rahim followed him soon. Mahmudullah and Afif Hossain hit some boundaries in the death overs to keep the game alive but their departure in successive overs was the final nail in the coffin for Bangladesh. Mahedi Hasan did hit a few boundaries in the last over, but it was not enough for them.

What a win for Scotland! They were down and out in the first innings but came back strong to put on a good score on the board. Then they walked out on the field and bowled with fire to defend it. What a way to get the T20 World Cup underway for Scotland. Bangladesh, on the other hand, would be very disappointed with the way this game turned out for them. Celebrations in the Scotland camp and they have deserved this victory!

That is it! Scotland have handed Bangladesh a defeat in their opening game! Back of a length, around off. Mahedi Hasan pulls it to deep mid-wicket and can only manage a single. Scotland WIN THE MATCH BY 6 RUNS!
FOUR! Another full toss, around off. Mahedi Hasan carves it past covers for a boundary. 8 runs needed off the last ball!
They are checking for a no ball here! Could be a game-changing moment but it seems fine for now and it is not termed as a no ball which means Bangladesh need 12 from two.

SIX! BANG! Well, well! Is there a twist in the tale? Sharif serves a juicy full toss, on middle and leg. Mahedi Hasan stays back and sends it sailing way over deep square leg for a maximum! 12 runs needed off 2 balls!
Top delivery! A yorker, around middle and leg. Mohammad Saifuddin squeezes it out to the left of the bowler for a run.
FOUR! Bangladesh more of these if they are to win this game now! Length ball, outside off. Mohammad Saifuddin lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
The physio is out as Mahedi Hasan hit the ball onto his helmet. He seems fine though.
Leg bye! Full ball, around leg. Mahedi Hasan gets low and looks to scoop it over the keeper but he gets an inside edge onto his pads. The batters take a run.
Safyaan Sharif to bowl the last over. He has plenty of runs to defend. 23 to be precise. Can Bangladesh spring in a surprise?
Good-length ball, around off. Mahedi Hasan lofts it to mid off and takes a run. 24 runs needed off the last over!
Mohammad Saifuddin walks out to bat!

OUT! TAKEN! Oh, dear! That probably should be the game for Scotland as Bangladesh lose their skipper! Full ball, in the slot, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to smash it over long on but it takes the toe end and the ball goes to that man again, Calum MacLeod at long on who takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Calum MacLeod b Brad Wheal

Commentary.Commentary: Excellent delivery! Yorker-length delivery, around off. Mahmudullah digs it out back to the bowler.
SIX! BANG! Mahmudullah breaks the shackles! Wheal hurls a slower ball, on a length, outside off. Mahmudullah frees his arms and tonks it way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Mahedi Hasan walks out to bat now!

OUT! CAUGHT! Another good catch from Calum MacLeod and Bangladesh slip further! A slower ball, on a length, around off. Nurul Hasan looks to go downtown but it takes the toe end of the bat and the ball lobs up in the air towards long on. Calum MacLeod there, takes the catch, he realizes the momentum is taking him over the ropes. He throws it up inside the ropes, comes back and takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Calum MacLeod b Brad Wheal

Commentary.Commentary: A low full toss, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to slog hard but it takes the outside edge to the right of the keeper. The keeper dives to his right and stops a certain boundary. A single taken.
Brad Wheal to bowl now. He has been given the 19th. probably the most important over of the game. 32 needed.
Full ball, outside off. Nurul Hasan digs it out towards sweeper cover and collects a couple. 32 runs needed off 2 overs!
Yorker-length ball, around off. Nurul Hasan digs it out back to the bowler.
Full ball, on the pads. Mahmudullah works it to long on for a run.

OUT! CAUGHT! A huge wicket this for Scotland and Bangladesh lose their fifth wicket! Watt fires in a quicker ball, on a length, around middle. Afif Hossain looks to heave it away but it goes off the inner half of the bat straight to Josh Davey at deep mid-wicket who takes a good catch. 50th T20I wicket for Mark Watt. Nurul Hasan walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Davey b Mark Watt

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker ball, fuller in length, outside off. Mahmudullah drills it hard towards long off for just a run.
Full ball, around off. Afif Hossain squeezes it out towards long off to collect a single.
Mark Watt to bowl his last.

FOUR! Nicely done by the skipper, Mahmudullah! A full ball, outside off. Mahmudullah shuffles across and reverse-scoops it. The ball flies over the keeper and goes into the fence! 37 runs needed off 18 balls!
Short ball, outside off. Afif Hossain reaches out and punches it to cover for one.
Slower ball, dragged down. Mahmudullah is early into his pull and the ball rolls towards deep square leg for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Afif Hossain drills it to long off for a run.
FOUR! Cheeky from young Afif Hossain! A low full toss, on middle. Afif Hossain gets low, shuffles across and scoops it over the keeper for a boundary.
Slower ball, banged in short, around leg. Mahmudullah miscues his pull and the ball goes to short fine leg. A single taken!
Just the one! Fuller and on middle, Mahmudullah hits it down to long on. No timing again, just a single.
Just the one! On middle, Afif Hossain pulls it towards square leg for only one. Singles won't harm Scotland.
Put down! That is a tough chance though! Outside off, Afif slashes at it. It goes off the underedge and hits the lower part of the gloves of the keeper. He had no time to react.

JUST IN! Not the best of running from Afif Hossain! Shorter and outside off, this is cut past point. They go for the second after finishing one. The fielder in the deep hits the stumps at the keeper's end but Afif is in.
Does not time it at all again! On middle, comes down the track does Mahmudullah, makes it into a full toss but it goes off the bottom towards long on for one.
A dot! Dots are gold! A yorker outside off, Mahmudullah jams it out to covers.

FOUR! Wheal can't believe how Afif Hossain has hit that for a boundary! Even we can't, what a delivery that was. A yorker on middle, Afif Hossain manages to jam it out, he just opens the face at the end and plays it past short third man for a boundary. Spoils the over a little but still a good one. 54 needed in 5 overs.
This one lands safe! Shorter and on off, Mahmudullah looks to flat bat it, it goes off the splice towards mid off for one more. 58 needed in 31, run rate needed above 10. Can Wheal end it well?
Two! Mahmudullah skips down the track again, this time he connects with the fuller ball, drags it wide of long on for two.
Another swing and another miss! Pressure building on Mahmudullah! Length and outside off, looks to heave it over the leg side but no connection.
That has just missed the stumps! Close! Mahmudullah comes down the track and Wheal shortens the length and bowls it on middle. Mahmudullah swings but misses. It goes just over the leg pole.
Dots are gold at the moment! This is on a length and outside off, Mahmudullah looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
Just a tad short, outside off. Afif Hossain stays back and cuts it past the diving short third man fielder for a couple.
Loopy ball, around off. Mahmudullah taps it to backward point and collects a single.
Flatter ball, around off. Afif Hossain works it to long off for a run.
In the air, but safe! Tossed up, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to go over cover but it goes off the outer half of the bat towards sweeper cover. A single taken!
Flatter ball, on off. Afif Hossain taps it to point for a single.
Who will bat now? Afif Hossain it is.

OUT! BOWLED! It is that man again, Chris Greaves! What a game he is having! Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Mushfiqur Rahim shuffles across to scoop it over the keeper but he fails to get any bat on it and the ball clips the bails. Mushfiqur Rahim departs and Bangladesh are in a spot of bother!
Just the single from the over! Clever, clever bowling! Mahmudullah makes room. This is bowled wide outside off. Mahmudullah leaves it alone.
Just the one run from the 5 balls. Full and outside off, this is played to covers.
Just the one! Outstanding stuff! Very full and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Fuller this time, Rahim strokes it to covers. Three dots in a row.
Two dots in a row! Short and outside off again, Rahim cuts but to point.
Goes very wide of the crease and bowls it shorter and outside off, Rahim guides it to point.
Mark Watt comes back into the attack.
Shorter ball, outside off. Rahim pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Cut away to point.
Flatter ball, down the leg side. Rahim misses the flick. Wide called.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Bangladesh! Shorter ball, on off. Rahim pulls it away. The fielders from deep mid-wicket and deep square leg converge. The man from deep mid-wicket dives but the ball runs to the fence.
Tossed up, on off. Mahmudullah gets down the track and heaves it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter ball, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Mahedi Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! There comes the big wicket of Shakib Al Hasan! A nothing delivery to get the big wicket. Shorter ball, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan goes for the pull but gets it from the toe end. The man from deep mid-wicket gets across to his right and Calum MacLeod takes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Calum MacLeod b Chris Greaves

Commentary.Commentary: Chris Greaves comes to bowl.
A yorker, on off. Pushed to covers for a quick single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. Had he hit, Shakib Al Hasan was a goner.
Well bowled. Slower and shorter, way outside off. Shakib Al Hasan goes for the pull but misses.
Shakib Al Hasan comes down the track so Josh Davey fires a wide one. Left alone and a wide called.
Short ball, outside off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Shakib swipes it to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, outside off. Rahim dabs it to third man for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Cut away to deep point for one.

Drinks Break! The game looks nicely poised but Bangladesh would breathe easy until these two experienced batters are at the crease! Scotland would look to break this pasrtnership as early as possible as they will be well aware of the threat that these two Bangladeshi batters possess, and not to forget, they bat deep too. Josh Davey (2-0-6-1) comes back into the attack.
Shorter ball, outside off. Shakib heaves it to long on for one.
Shorter ball, on off. Rahim cuts it but the man at point dives and gets a hand to it. A single is taken as the ball goes past him.
Flatter ball, on off. Cut away to short cover and another misfield allows a single.
Darted on the pads. Tucked to long on for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Rahim cuts it away and a misfield at point allows a couple of runs.
Shorter ball, on off. Heaved down to long on for one.
Flatter ball, on off. Rahim taps it with soft hands to wide long on. They scamper back for the second.
SIX! He has done it again! Tossed up, outside off. Rahim gets under it and sweeps it way over the mid-wicket fence.
SIX! Oh, that is pumped and Rahim is getting in the groove now! Darted on the pads. He gets low and slog-sweeps it over the square leg fence.
Flatter ball, on leg. Rahim scoops it past the diving short fine leg fielder for a couple.
Flatter ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan heaves it to long on for one.
Shorter ball, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim cuts it to sweeper cover for one.
A half-tracker, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and miscues his pull towards long on. The batters cross for a single.
Flatter ball, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim eases it down to long off for a run.
Loopy ball, on middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan skips down and drills it to long on for a brace!
Just a tad short, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim rocks back and cuts hard. The fielder at backward point dives and keeps it down to one.
Flatter ball, around off. Shakib Al Hasan stays back and turns it to the leg side for a single.
Mark Watt comes on now.
Quicker ball, around middle and leg. Mushfiqur Rahim tucks it to the right of the bowler. Just 2 runs off the over!
A tad short, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim rocks back to cut but he misses.
Leg bye! Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan misses the flick and the ball rolls to short fine leg after clipping his pads. A leg bye taken!
Tossed up, on off. Mushfiqur Rahim works it to long off for a run.
Flatter ball, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it off the back foot.
A low full toss, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Michael Leask comes in the attack now.
Length ball, down leg. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks but finds the short fine leg fielder. Bangladesh are 25/2 at the end of the Powerplay.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Mushfiqur Rahim turns it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it off the back foot as the ball hurries onto him.
On a length, around middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Review time! Scotland have reviewed this for LBW. But the ball is pitching outside leg.

NOT OUT! Scotland lose their review! Good-length ball, around leg. Shakib Al Hasan skips down and looks to whip it off his pads but he misses and gets hit on the pads. Scotland opt for a review but the Ball Tracker confirms it was pitched well outside leg.
Good-length ball, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim taps it to the left of the bowler and scampers through for one.
Wide! Safyaan Sharif spills this one way down leg. Wide called as Mushfiqur Rahim misses his flick.
Safyaan Sharif is back on. He went for 6 in his first over.
Back of a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to block it out but it goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg.
Good-length ball, on leg. Mushfiqur Rahim turns it to mid-wicket and takes a run.
Good-length ball, shaping away from off. Mushfiqur Rahim defends it out.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan tucks it to the leg side and collects a single.
Good-length ball, around leg. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Review time! Scotland have taken a review for LBW. There is no bat on that one but Ball Tracker shows it is umpire's call on hitting!

NOT OUT! Mushfiqur Rahim survives! Length ball, jagging back in from off. Mushfiqur Rahim looks to defend but he misses and gets hit high on the pads. Scotland appeal but turned down. Kyle Coetzer opts for a review but the wickets hitting is umpire's call and the on-field decision stays.
Josh Davey is back on. He went for 3 in his first over.

Scotland have their tails up at the moment! Brilliant fielding! On the pads, Shakib Al Hasan flicks it nicely but to mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to his left and stops it. Kyle Coetzer it is, the skipper leading from the front. Brilliant over by Wheal.
Angled into the pads, Rahim works it through square leg for one. He is off the mark.

A huge appeal but there was probably an inside edge. Yes, a big one. On off, this one jags back in. Rahim looks to defend but he gets an inside edge onto the pads. Had there not been one, it could have well been another wicket.
Who will bat now? Mushfiqur Rahim it is.

OUT! TAKEN! Wicket number two down. Both the openers back in the hut within the Powerplay. Just what Scotland would have wanted. Still 123 more needed. Das comes down the track but gets a little too close to the pitch of the ball. He tries to go over mid off but hits it to the fielder there. George Munsey, this time had to move a little to his right and takes an easy catch. Bangladesh in a spot of bother here. Second catch for Munsey. He is everywhere at the moment.
Commentary.Howout: c George Munsey b Brad Wheal

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter this time and on middle, Shakib Al Hasan looks to hit it hard but it goes more of the splice towards deep square leg for one.
Shakib Al Hasan misses out! Full and wide outside off, Shakib thrashes it but to covers.
Change. Brad Wheal is back on. He went for 7 in his first over.
Really good delivery! That is nice and quick! Shorter and outside off, comes back in late. Shakib looks to cut, it hits the glove and rolls on the leg side for one.
Shakib skips down the track this time and this is banged in short. Does not bounce a lot. Shakib looks to pull but misses. It goes over the stumps.
FOUR! Nicely played! A slower one, on the pads, Shakib Al Hasan places it behind square on the leg side for a welcome boundary. First for Shakib Al Hasan.
Length and on off, Shakib guides it to point.
Good length and on off, Das guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Fuller and on the pads, this one tails back in. Shakib looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye.
Safyaan Sharif comes into the attack.
Slightly fuller and on off, Shakib strokes it wide of mid off for one.
Angles it into the pads, Shakib works it to mid-wicket.
Good length and on off, Das guides it to point and takes one.
Shakib Al Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man! The fielder does not have to move an inch and that is brilliant field placement! It is a strong area for Sarkar but he falls in trying to find the boundary there. There was a fielder placed in the deep mid-wicket region. Davey angles it into the pads, wanting Sarkar to go over the leg side. Sarkar does flick it uppishly and straight to the man at deep mid-wicket. Munsey takes an easy catch. An early wicket for Scotland.
Commentary.Howout: c George Munsey b Josh Davey

Commentary.Commentary: Angled into the pads, Das works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
BEATEN! That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and then moves away. Das looks to defend but is beaten.
Who will bowl from the other end? Josh Davey it is.
Good length and on off, defended. A decent start for Bangladesh.
Das now takes a single! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A single now! On off, Sarkar taps it towards cover and takes one.
Shorter in length and outside off, Sarkar looks to cut but it goes off the underedge to the keeper.
FOUR! That is a very confident shot to get off the mark! A shot of authority! On middle, swings in, Sarkar with the movement, whips it over mid-wicket. A one-bounce boundary.
Bangladesh and Das are underway! Length and on off, this one shapes away. Das looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
